description: Lists the signature requests of one case file. Requires: case_file_create → caseFileId. Optional filters: filter.status (one status) or filter.statuses (several), each one of CREATING, DRAFT, ACTIVE, PARTIALLY_SIGNED, FULLY_SIGNED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED, REJECTED, CLOSING or COMPLETED_MANUAL; filter.createdFrom and filter.createdUntil (ISO 8601 date-time); filter.search (free text); filter.id. order.createdAt sorts ASC or DESC; page paginates. Returns { data, meta }; use an item's id as requestId in signature_request_get and the other signature tools.
name: signature_request_list
